item.title: 【Unreleased/Unofficial (lossless)】FLAC - Bon Iver - Bon Iver (2011) [5.1 Surround Stem Mix] [FLAC / 24bit]
item.description:
Hey everyone! This is my very first time uploading here, and I just wanted to share something really cool I put together.

Here is a special multi-channel treat for Bon Iver and surround sound enthusiasts!

This project is an independent 5.1 surround sound mix of Bon Iver's self-titled 2011 album. It was originally compiled by an incredible mixer on YouTube named Jared (Methuselah's Grandpa)! He sourced the audio from the official 2012 Spotify Stems Project, resulting in a brilliant, highly discrete instrument panorama with a massive benchmark dynamic range of [DR16].
You can check out his channel and listen to the stream right here:

On his page, Jared explicitly noted that web browsers block native YouTube 5.1 playback, forcing a flat stereo downmix on computers. To fix this restriction for the community, I used yt-dlp to extract his raw multi-channel stream directly from the servers. Then, I used foobar2000 alongside a custom .cue script to perform a bit-perfect, lossless split of the timeline into 10 individual tracks. Now, anyone can play this masterpiece perfectly on a PC via foobar2000 or MPC-HC with true, uncompressed 5.1 surround sound.

Tracklist:
01 - Perth
02 - Minnesota, WI
03 - Holocene
04 - Towers
05 - Michicant
06 - Hinnom, TX
07 - Wash.
08 - Calgary
09 - Lisbon, OH
10 - Beth / Rest
